author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing was a moustached bust with a thin band across the head; neither the wide diving mask nor the snorkel of the original read, and it added a body the reference lacks.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. A head with a wide rounded mask jutting past both cheeks and a J-shaped snorkel from the mouth rising beside the head; reads as a snorkel diver at 48.
omissions: Mask nose notch, mouthpiece ring (no 8-unit room at the jaw) and neck.
lucide_reference: Rounded-rectangle 'glasses' band; no snorkel in Lucide.
human_reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg (head proportions); head portrait with no body.
